## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link the approved issue for substantial or behavior-changing work.

## Verification

List commands and outcomes, plus any unverified behavior. For UI changes, include desktop/mobile evidence using sample data. For provider changes, include evidence rules and relevant found/not_found/unknown fixtures.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves honest uncertain-result handling.
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, private data, or identifiable lookup results are included.
- [ ] Relevant checks and their outcomes are recorded above.
- [ ] I understand that @4ryanwalia must explicitly approve this pull request before merge.
